Subject: Q1 invoices - split by legal entity / remittance file attached

Hi Connor,

We received the consolidated invoice you sent for Q1 but our accounting team needs the charges split across two billed entities (Clearwave US and Clearwave EU branch) so our AP system can post them to separate GLs. Attached is a remittance snapshot showing how our payment will be applied today if we receive the line-level split.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood reissue the invoice with two invoice lines reflecting the entity split and include the correct VAT tags (we're in the US but some customers route via EU for partner services)?
- Please include our PO# 47821 on each reissued line.
- We need bank remittance instructions to validate that payments will route to the correct payee entity.

We're on a tight cycle and would like an updated invoice by EOD Monday if possible.

Thanks,
Laura Bates
Director, Accounts Payable
Clearwave Health

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the remittance file. Looping in Marissa (billing ops) and Karthik (tax) to confirm the mapping and VAT handling.

Marissa / Karthik — Laura's team needs the single invoice split into two billed entities. We typically support per-line entity tagging and can include PO# 47821 on each line. To proceed we need:
- Confirmation of the exact split amounts (unless Redwood should split per product allocation below)
- Whether the EU-side should be treated as VAT-exempt or subject to reverse charge (Clearwave's AP indicated partner routing)

I've attached a quick allocation template we use to map invoice rows to entities — can you confirm and return by EOD so we can reissue?

Laura — we'll aim to reissue as a credit + two new invoices once Marissa confirms. If we can't hit EOD Monday we'll target first thing Tuesday and will flag any tax implications up front.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Thanks Connor. Laura — I took a look at your remittance snapshot and your PO. I've filled the allocation template with a suggested split that follows the services used by each legal entity (attached). Summary:
- Invoice 2028-001 (credit to void original consolidated invoice)
- Invoice 2028-002 (Clearwave US) — $42,000 — no VAT, GL: 4001 — PO 47821
- Invoice 2028-003 (Clearwave EU) — €8,500 — reported as reverse charge (no VAT collected) — PO 47821

- Laura, we can include the bank remittance instructions on each invoice header; can you confirm the exact payee name for the EU settlement? Your remittance file shows both 'Clearwave Health LLC' and 'Clearwave Health Europe' as possible payees.

If we get confirmation on payee and VAT treatment, I'll have the credit + two new invoices generated and sent to your AP inbox by Tuesday 12pm PT.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
